tools.name: get_webtoffee_api_catalog
tools.description: List the public API endpoints WebToffee exposes for agents (RFC 8288 API catalog), with a short description of what each endpoint returns.

tools.name: get_webtoffee_changelog
tools.description: Get the latest changelog entries for a WebToffee WordPress plugin by name or slug.

product.description: Plugin name or slug, e.g. "PDF Invoices for WooCommerce".

tools.description: Get a description, current pricing, and license tiers for a WebToffee WordPress plugin by name or slug.

product.description: Plugin name or slug, e.g. "Import Export Suite for WooCommerce".
